scenarios.description: During a period of market stress affecting TheIndex, Solactive calculates TheIndex following the SolactiveDisruptionArrangements, which are predefined, exhaustive, and described in the SolactiveDisruptionPolicy available on the Solactive website.
During a period of market stress, Solactive calculates TheIndex using an ad hoc arrangement that is neither predefined nor exhaustive and is not described in the SolactiveDisruptionPolicy.
A market stress period occurs, but there is no evidence that prices for any Index Component become inaccurate or delayed, and no evidence that the index determination is limited or impaired.

A fragmented market exists at a time when no market stress is stated; Solactive does not yet calculate the index differently, but the index determination is claimed to be limited or impaired at that time.
